name: Zenith Zantetsuken
effects: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Instant Cast 1] to all allies with Attach Lightning or Attach Dark, grants [Attach Lightning 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Dark 2 with Stacking] based on element of entry damage, [Damage Cap +10000], [Zenith Mode], and [Zenith Mode: Ravus (Lightning, Dark)] to the user

description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Instant Cast 1] to all allies with Attach Lightning or Attach Dark, grants [Attach Lightning 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Dark 2 with Stacking] based on element of entry damage, [Damage Cap +10000], [Zenith Mode], and [Zenith Mode: Ravus (Lightning, Dark)] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Ravus (Lightning, Dark)
description.text: Increases [Lightning/Dark Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for PHY attacks, Lightning or Dark abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Ravus after using a Lightning or Dark ability (max 1), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Last Rites+
description.text: Six single attacks (? each) capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses

description.name: Spirit Attack: Ravus
description.text: Grants [Damage Cap +10000 2]/[Damage Cap +10000 2] and [(Lightning/Dark) Ability +30% Boost 2] to the user/all allies if there are 0-2/3+ allies with Attach Lightning or Dark in the party

description.name: Attach Lightning 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3

description.name: Attach Dark 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Dark Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Dark 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
